## History

Bentley served as the pastor of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for eighteen years, having already arrived in the community as a widower and remaining one throughout his time there. During his tenure, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) found him to be lacking in imagination.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004)_
